title: Chapter 1
text: Authors Note: What follows is based on actual occurrences. Although much has been changed for rhetorical purposes, it must be regarded in its essence as fact. However, it should in no way be associated with that great body of factual information relating to orthodox Zen Buddhist practice. Its not very factual on motorcycles, either. And what is good, Phćdrus, And what is not good Need we ask anyone to tell us these things?
